articles.title: Subject matter
articles.requirement: Scope of DORA — ICT risk management, incident reporting, resilience testing, third-party risk

articles.title: Scope of application
articles.requirement: Defines which financial entities are in scope; proportionality for smaller entities

articles.title: Definitions
articles.requirement: ICT risk, ICT incident, operational resilience, critical ICT third-party provider, etc.

articles.title: Proportionality
articles.requirement: Apply DORA proportionate to size, nature, scale, and complexity; microenterprises have lighter obligations

articles.title: ICT governance
articles.requirement: Management body defines ICT strategy; approves ICT risk tolerance; accountable for ICT risk

articles.title: ICT risk management framework
articles.requirement: Documented ICT risk management framework; reviewed at least annually; approved by management body

articles.title: ICT systems, protocols and tools
articles.requirement: Adequate, resilient ICT systems; capacity planning; network segmentation; encryption standards

articles.title: Identification
articles.requirement: Identify all ICT assets; classify by criticality; maintain up-to-date inventory; document dependencies

articles.title: Protection and prevention
articles.requirement: ICT security policies; access controls; change management; patch management; endpoint protection

articles.title: Detection
articles.requirement: Anomaly detection mechanisms; monitoring of ICT infrastructure; SIEM/logging requirements

articles.title: Response and recovery
articles.requirement: ICT-related incident response plans; BCP/DRP; RTO and RPO defined and tested

articles.title: Backup policies
articles.requirement: Backup and recovery procedures; regular testing; backup integrity verification; geographic separation

articles.title: Learning and evolving
articles.requirement: Post-incident analysis; update frameworks based on lessons learned; threat intelligence integration

articles.title: Communication
articles.requirement: ICT crisis communication plans; internal escalation; external stakeholder communication

articles.title: Simplified ICT risk framework
articles.requirement: Simplified framework for smaller entities; must still cover core elements

articles.title: Microenterprise ICT risk
articles.requirement: Specific lighter obligations for microenterprises; key risk controls still required

articles.title: ICT-related incident classification
articles.requirement: Classify incidents by impact, duration, affected services, data loss; apply classification criteria

articles.title: Major incident classification
articles.requirement: Criteria for 'major' incident: number of clients affected, transaction volume, geographic spread, criticality

articles.title: Reporting of major incidents
articles.requirement: Report major incidents to competent authority: initial (4h), intermediate (24h), final (1 month)

articles.title: Voluntary notification
articles.requirement: May voluntarily report significant cyber threats; competent authority may request additional info

articles.title: Incident report content
articles.requirement: Initial report: type, date/time, impact, preliminary cause; final report: root cause, resolution, lessons

articles.title: Reporting to clients
articles.requirement: Notify affected clients of major incidents without undue delay; provide updates on resolution

articles.title: Supervisory feedback
articles.requirement: Competent authorities provide feedback on incident reports; guidance on similar incidents sector-wide

articles.title: Digital operational resilience testing programme
articles.requirement: Annual DORA testing programme; scope, frequency, types of tests; reviewed by management body

articles.title: Testing of ICT tools
articles.requirement: Threat-led penetration testing (TLPT), vulnerability assessments, network security assessments

articles.title: Threat-led penetration testing
articles.requirement: TLPT at least every 3 years for significant entities; cover critical systems; external testers

articles.title: Remediation requirements
articles.requirement: Remediate findings from testing; track remediation; management body oversight of residual risk

articles.title: ICT third-party risk management
articles.requirement: Policy for ICT third-party risk; risk-based approach; pre-contractual due diligence

articles.title: Preliminary assessment
articles.requirement: Assess ICT third-party risks before contracting; proportionate to criticality of service

articles.title: Key contractual provisions
articles.requirement: Mandatory contractual elements for ICT services: SLAs, audit rights, exit plans, subcontracting

articles.title: Critical ICT third-party providers
articles.requirement: Designation of critical ICT TPPs by ESAs; oversight framework led by Lead Overseer

articles.title: Structure of oversight framework
articles.requirement: Lead Overseer: EBA, ESMA, or EIOPA; oversight team; access rights to critical TPPs

articles.title: Tasks of Lead Overseer
articles.requirement: Lead Overseer monitors critical TPP compliance; can request information, conduct inspections

articles.title: Powers of Lead Overseer
articles.requirement: Request documents; conduct on-site inspections; issue recommendations; impose penalties

articles.title: Exercise of oversight powers
articles.requirement: Procedural rules for oversight; right of reply; appeals; publication of decisions

articles.title: Oversight fees
articles.requirement: Annual supervisory fees for designated critical ICT third-party providers

articles.title: International oversight cooperation
articles.requirement: ESAs cooperate with third-country authorities on critical ICT TPPs established outside EU

articles.title: Register of information
articles.requirement: Maintain register of all ICT third-party arrangements; report to competent authority annually

articles.title: Contractual arrangements for ICT services
articles.requirement: Right to audit ICT TPPs; exit strategies; subcontracting oversight; data location requirements

articles.title: Subcontracting
articles.requirement: Assess subcontracting arrangements; no unlimited subcontracting chains; audit rights flow down

articles.title: Concentration risk
articles.requirement: Monitor and manage ICT concentration risk; avoid over-reliance on single providers or cloud regions

articles.title: Exit strategies
articles.requirement: Documented exit strategies for critical ICT services; tested; alternative provider identified

articles.title: ICT intragroup arrangements
articles.requirement: Intragroup ICT arrangements must comply with DORA; document; ensure no circumvention

articles.title: Information sharing
articles.requirement: Voluntary information sharing on cyber threats within sector; legal framework; confidentiality protections

articles.title: Competent authorities
articles.requirement: Designate competent authority for DORA supervision; powers of investigation and enforcement

articles.title: Supervisory powers
articles.requirement: On-site/off-site supervision; access to documents and systems; interview rights

articles.title: Cross-border cooperation
articles.requirement: Home/host authority cooperation; joint supervision of cross-border entities

articles.title: Peer reviews
articles.requirement: ESAs conduct peer reviews of supervisory practices; promote convergence

articles.title: Penalties — competent authority
articles.requirement: Administrative penalties for DORA breaches; up to 2% of total annual worldwide turnover

articles.title: Criminal sanctions
articles.requirement: Member States provide for criminal sanctions for DORA breaches; notification to ESAs

articles.title: Publication of decisions
articles.requirement: Publish enforcement decisions; anonymised for natural persons; 5-year retention

articles.title: Lead Overseer penalties
articles.requirement: Lead Overseer can impose penalties on critical ICT TPPs up to 1% of global daily turnover

articles.title: ICT third-party service providers — criminal
articles.requirement: Member States provide for criminal sanctions for critical ICT TPPs that obstruct oversight

articles.title: Reporting to Lead Overseer
articles.requirement: Critical ICT TPPs report incidents, material changes, and compliance breaches to Lead Overseer

articles.title: Amendment to EMIR
articles.requirement: Technical amendment to EMIR to align with DORA framework

articles.title: Amendment to Directive 2009/65/EC (UCITS)
articles.requirement: Amendment to align UCITS Directive with DORA

articles.title: Amendment to Solvency II
articles.requirement: Amendment to align Solvency II with DORA ICT risk requirements

articles.title: Amendment to MiFID II
articles.requirement: Amendment to MiFID II to align with DORA; reference to DORA ICT requirements

articles.title: Amendment to MiFIR
articles.requirement: Technical amendment to MiFIR

articles.title: Amendment to IDD
articles.requirement: Amendment to Insurance Distribution Directive

articles.title: Amendment to ELTIF
articles.requirement: Amendment to European Long-Term Investment Fund Regulation

articles.title: Amendment to CBDC/PSD2
articles.requirement: Amendment to Payment Services Directive 2

articles.title: Review
articles.requirement: Commission reviews DORA application by 2028; consider new technologies and risks

articles.title: Entry into force
articles.requirement: Entered into force 16 January 2023; applies from 17 January 2025
